_description: Cross-SDK DCP-09 §3.5.2 mandate domain vectors. Verdicts (normative): every chain verifier MUST accept each must_accept chain (root first), whose leaf depth and effective tier are expected.depth and expected.effective_tier, and MUST reject each must_reject chain, verified at verification_time against keys with revoked_mandate_ids revoked. A domain that appears twice in one mandate is not comparable (rule 5), at every depth, the root included. Domains are the exact strings the JSON decodes to: no case folding, no trimming, no Unicode normalization, so the case, space and code point variants of must_accept are distinct domains and a sub-mandate entry matches only the parent entry with the very same string. Diagnostics (not normative): errors lists, in order, what the reference chain verifiers of the TypeScript, Python, Go and Rust SDKs report for each must_reject chain, kept as a regression of those APIs. DCP-09 fixes no error text and no order, and an implementation that rejects these chains with other errors conforms. These verifiers report each repeated domain of a mandate whose authority_scope entries are all well formed once, at its second entry, among the errors of that mandate own fields and before its signature is looked at. Every signature is real (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65, pq_over_classical): the root by the human, each sub-mandate by its parent agent. Key material is synthetic, generated for these vectors only.
